description.narrative: (El Salvador): The Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) activity provides an umbrella mechanism instrument through which the USAID/El Salvador and Central America & Mexico Regional Mission, other USAID bilateral missions in the region, and USAID/Washington-based Bureaus and Offices in Central America can request MEL, knowledge management, and geographic information systems support services. This mechanism will measure programmatic impacts, results, and achievements; facilitate learning and adaptive management; and contract individual or longitudinal studies, analyses, and assessments on certain sectors or issues relevant to programs for bilateral and regional strategies. The expected overall result of the MEL contract is to enhance USAID's regional MEL capacity, and the use of empirical evidence for programming, learning and adapting. The MEL activity is uniquely positioned to provide these services due to the IP's extensive experience supporting USAID to effectively conduct MEL practices in support of reporting, learning and adaptive management, and institutionalizing best practices in Missions. The activity supports the ICS and RCS in their entirety by supporting USAID to effectively use data and evidence to inform and improve programming towards achievement of high level outcomes
